remediation.suggestion: Use fenced examples sparingly and document that inline backticks denote text, paths, or labels rather than executable commands.

remediation.suggestion: Keep cross-skill references as Markdown links and ensure saved filenames use validated account or goal labels.

content.value_statement: First-party customer data often lacks a clear, reusable audience plan. This skill turns approved CRM or GA4 exports into named seeds, exclusions, and funnel-stage targeting maps.
actual_capabilities: Identifies available CRM or GA4 columns for segmentation.
Defines named seed audiences tied to customer traits or behavior.
Ranks high-value customer groups for value-based lookalike seeds.
Creates exclusion and suppression rules for customers and recent purchasers.
Maps cold, warm, hot, and customer audiences across ad platforms.
Flags missing data as NEEDS_INPUT instead of guessing.
limitations: It does not upload audiences to advertising platforms.
It does not create campaigns, ad groups, or match types.
Segment quality depends on the completeness of supplied first-party exports.
It does not replace legal review of consent, privacy, or platform policies.

use_cases.title: Prepare a prospecting launch
use_cases.description: Build high-value seeds and cold audience definitions before a new acquisition campaign.

use_cases.title: Reduce wasted retargeting spend
use_cases.description: Define recent-purchaser and existing-customer exclusions with clear suppression windows.

use_cases.title: Standardize platform targeting
use_cases.description: Translate GA4 or CRM signals into one funnel map for Google, Meta, and other platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: segment a customer export
prompt_templates.scenario: Start from a basic customer CSV.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build audience segments from my customer export. My goal is direct response. Identify useful columns, name each segment, and flag missing data.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: create value-based seeds
prompt_templates.scenario: Use customer value fields for prospecting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my CRM export to define value-based lookalike seed audiences. Rank groups by lifetime value, state the seed criteria, and create exclusions for current customers.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: map a multi-platform funnel
prompt_templates.scenario: Reuse one audience strategy across platforms.
prompt_templates.prompt: Map my GA4 and CRM audiences to cold, warm, hot, and customer funnel stages for Google and Meta. Include retargeting windows, suppression rules, and NEEDS_INPUT flags.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: review privacy-safe output
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a handoff without exposing personal data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a privacy-aware audience segment handoff from this export. Use aggregate descriptions only, do not repeat raw PII, and list every source column used.

output_examples.input: A CRM export with lifetime value, last purchase date, and plan tier.
output: High-value repeat buyers: customers in the top lifetime-value tier with two or more purchases.
Recent purchasers: customers who purchased within 30 days; suppress from acquisition campaigns.
Needs input: no acquisition source column was supplied for source-based segments.

output_examples.input: A GA4 audience export for Google and Meta.
output: Cold: new visitors and eligible lookalike expansion audiences.
Warm: engaged visitors within the stated retargeting window.
Hot: checkout or pricing-page visitors, excluding recent purchasers.

best_practices: Use only approved first-party exports and confirm data-use permissions before segmentation.
Tie every audience definition to a supplied column, value, or stated behavior.
Use aggregate descriptions or hashes and keep raw PII out of the handoff.
anti_patterns: Do not invent value tiers, retargeting windows, or fit signals that are absent from the export.
Do not include raw email addresses, phone numbers, or customer rows in the output.
Do not treat segment definitions as a substitute for campaign structure or platform policy review.

faq.question: What data can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide an approved CRM, customer, or GA4 export with column names and aggregate values where possible.

faq.question: Does this skill upload audiences?
faq.answer: No. It defines audience plans and seed criteria. Platform uploads require separate approval and tooling.

faq.question: Can it create lookalike audiences?
faq.answer: It creates value-based seed definitions. The advertising platform performs lookalike expansion.

faq.question: How does it protect PII?
faq.answer: It instructs the agent to use aggregate or hashed descriptions and not echo raw emails or phone numbers.

faq.question: Which platforms can use the output?
faq.answer: The funnel map is platform-neutral and can support Google, Meta, and other advertising platforms.

faq.question: What happens when required data is missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks the affected segment as NEEDS_INPUT rather than making an unsupported assumption.
